newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold, silver prices finish higher.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold, silver prices finish higher.

text.p: Gold prices ended higher on Friday despite scattered profit-taking after the market opened strongly, dealers said.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) rose 200 rupees per piece at 56,900 at close, off day's opening high of 57,000 rupees, after losing 100 rupees on Thursday.
Volume was low due to poor attendance following disruption of transport system by striking workers after a leading union leader was killed on Thursday.
Silver prices were moderately higher on overnight rally in the world market and fresh industrial demand, dealers said.
